emptyLibraryText: Search for a game and mark what you're playing, have beaten or want to play.
statusHint: Tap the status again to remove the game from your collection.
commentsLocked: Comments may contain story spoilers. They show up once you mark that you're playing or have beaten it.
welcomeText: Search for a game and mark whether you want to play it, are playing it or have beaten it. You can rate and comment, just like movies.
discoverHint: Mark games as Playing or Beaten to get similar picks here.

steam.whereToFind: Paste your profile link. In the Steam app: open your profile → ⋯ → Copy URL. On PC: Profile → right-click the page → Copy Page URL. Login names and nicknames don't work because Steam doesn't allow searching by them.
steam.private: Private profile: playtime and achievements won't show
steam.privacyHelp: To show your achievements: on Steam, go to Profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings and set “My profile” and “Game details” to Public.
steam.invite: Link your Steam to see your achievements for this game
steam.cardPrivate: Your Steam game details are private, so playtime and achievements can't be shown.
steam.nicknameNotSupported: That looks like your nickname, and Steam doesn't allow searching by nickname. Paste your profile link (in the Steam app: profile → ⋯ → Copy URL).
steam.notFoundHelp: We couldn't find that profile. If you typed your login name or nickname, those don't work: paste your profile link (in the Steam app: profile → ⋯ → Copy URL).
steam.syncHint: Your Library syncs on its own: what you play on Steam is added as Playing when you open the Library or pull to refresh. Games already there stay as they are, and a game you remove only comes back if you play it again.

accounts.intro: Link your profiles to see playtime, achievements and trophies on each game's page. What you play is added to your Library automatically. No password needed: we only read what's already public on your profile.
accounts.unlinkBody: Your data from this platform will no longer show. Games in your Library stay there.
accounts.syncDone_one: {{count}} game was added to your Library as Playing.
accounts.syncDone_other: {{count}} games were added to your Library as Playing.
accounts.syncAlready: Nothing new: what you played in the last 14 days is already in your Library.
accounts.importOfferBody: We can add every game you've played on {{platform}} to your Library: 100% games as Beaten, the last 30 days as Playing and the rest as Played.
accounts.importDoneBody: We found {{found}} games on your account, recognized {{matched}} and {{added}} were added to your Library. Games already there didn't change.

psn.whereToFind: It's your PlayStation name (e.g. Player_123). On the console: Profile; in the PlayStation app: tap your avatar.
psn.notFoundHelp: We couldn't find that ID. Check capital letters, _ and - (it's the Online ID, not your email).
psn.privacyHelp: To show your trophies: on the console, go to Settings → Users and Accounts → Privacy → View and Customize → Trophies and choose “Anyone”. In the PlayStation app: Settings → Privacy Settings.
psn.syncHint: Your Library syncs on its own: games where you earn a trophy are added as Playing. Sony only exposes activity when you earn trophies, so a game with no new trophy won't show up. Unofficial integration: it may stop working without notice.
psn.invite: Link your PSN to see your trophies for this game
psn.cardPrivate: Your PSN trophies are private, so progress can't be shown.

xbox.whereToFind: It's your Xbox name (e.g. Player123 or Player#1234). On the console or in the Xbox app, open your profile.
xbox.notFoundHelp: We couldn't find that gamertag. Check the spelling and, if it has one, the #1234 suffix.
xbox.privacyHelp: To show your achievements: at account.xbox.com/Settings (or on the console: Settings → Account → Privacy & online safety), set “Others can see your game and app history” to Everyone.
xbox.syncHint: Your Library syncs on its own: what you play on Xbox (or the Xbox app on PC) is added as Playing. Unofficial integration: it may stop working without notice.
xbox.invite: Link your Xbox to see your achievements for this game
xbox.cardPrivate: Your Xbox game history is private, so achievements can't be shown.
